caption: The drawing depicts a ceramic jug shaped and decorated to resemble a human face, shown from both the front and the side. The jug has a rounded olive-green glazed body with a spout at the top and a handle on the rear, visible in the side view. The facial features on the jug are sculpted and painted in relief: bulging white eyes with dark pupils and brownish lids, a long protruding nose with darker shading, large pinkish-brown ears on either side, and a wide open mouth exposing uneven, yellowish-red and white teeth and gums. The mouth is painted in shades of red and pink, giving it a fleshy appearance. Additional sculptural details on the jug’s face include raised cheekbones and accentuated brow ridges, with shadowed areas providing depth. The side view shows the handle arching upward from the upper side to the back. The background consists of plain, slightly yellowed paper. The artist's name, "Yolande Delasser," is noted in the lower right corner.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
